name: Whipped Feta Dip

items: ½ cup mayonnaise, best quality such as Hellman’s or Duke’s
¼ tsp freshly ground black pepper
⅛ tsp crushed red pepper flakes, plus more for serving
Extra virgin olive oil, for drizzling
Toasted pita wedges (or pita chips) and/or sliced vegetables

steps.title: Blend the dip
steps.body: Combine all the ingredients in a food processor or blender and process until smooth: **8 oz block feta cheese**, **½ cup sour cream**, **½ cup mayonnaise**, **zest from 1 lemon** (about 1 tsp, packed), **1 small clove garlic**, chopped, **¼ tsp dried dill**, **¼ tsp dried oregano**, **¼ tsp dried thyme**, **⅛ tsp salt**, **¼ tsp freshly ground black pepper** and **⅛ tsp crushed red pepper flakes**.

steps.title: Season
steps.body: Taste and adjust seasoning, if necessary.

steps.title: Swirl and garnish
steps.body: Transfer to a serving bowl and use a small spoon to create a swirl on the surface of the dip. Drizzle with olive oil and sprinkle with toasted sesame seeds and crushed red pepper flakes, if using.

yields: About 2 cups, serves about 8 as an appetizer (estimated)
